summary.text: Louis McNutt is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 29 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Michael Holmstrom Jr.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a heavy equipment mechanic and union president of AFSCME Local 5.

paragraphs.text: McNutt said in a Ballotpedia survey that he works for the Minnesota Department of Transportation out of the Maple Grove station, is the father of three boys and the son of a school teacher, and has lived in Buffalo with his wife for more than 10 years.
He ran in the November 4, 2025 special general election for the same seat and lost to Michael Holmstrom Jr., 62.2 percent to 37.7 percent.
McNutt won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary with 58.6 percent of the vote over Dan Fiskum.

In the survey, McNutt listed his campaign messages as lowering the cost of living, a regulatory process for new data centers and a ban on AI-enabled surveillance cameras, and health care reform, including negotiating prescription drug prices.
He said he is the only DFL-endorsed candidate in the race and that he is also endorsed by AFSCME Council 5 and Education Minnesota, among other groups.
